_source: UNVERIFIED: the single-verify error body is not documented. Only {"status": "error", "reason": "..."} is documented, for the bulk endpoints (https://www.reoon.com/articles/api-documentation-of-reoon-email-verifier/, fetched 2026-10-04). The reason texts below are plausible wordings used to exercise the classifier, not recorded provider output. '{KEY}' is replaced with the test's sentinel key.

inactive_key_reason.reason: Your API key is not active

limit_reason.reason: Daily limit exceeded, no credits left

echoes_key.reason: The key {KEY} could not be authenticated, api key rejected
